BiblicalUsage: Fish stand in Scripture as part of the creaturely world God made and gave into human care, from the blessing of the sea creatures to the dominion spoken of in the psalm of creation. They also show up as food and as judgment: the prophet pictures men dragged up like fish in a net, and the fish of the sea are taken away when the land mourns. Jonah's great fish is the best-known of all, the creature God prepared to swallow the runaway prophet and bring him back.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the fish remind us how small our control really is. We fish, we net, we count the catch, yet the sea and everything in it belong to the Lord who made them, and He uses even a fish to carry out His purposes.
